original_normative_voice: A complete export contains every required identifier in the selected source snapshot, account and filter set.
proposed_normative_statement: For a fixed source snapshot S, declared account A, declared filters F and saved output E, export identifier completeness holds exactly when every identifier required by S, A and F appears in E.
source_note: The admitted Definition record establishes representation and authority boundaries. It does not establish the truth of INC-1042 or an external export policy.
